'''Kleeva''' was a massive [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] located within [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. It was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by at least three [[Moon/Legends|moons]], including [[Boonda's Moon]] and [[Vultee-Pietsch]].
